summary.intent: Clean up a stale git worktree and switch to a branch, then autonomously run the full post-execute-phase 'ship' loop (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve reviews → extract learnings) for GSD phase 69 (FUSE/WinFsp Rust integration and grant-root awareness).
summary.outcome: Worktree removed and branch checked out locally; Steps 1-3 of the ship loop completed — 69-VERIFICATION.md reached PASS (5/5 local success criteria, SC#5 CI-deferred), 69-SECURITY.md reached SECURED (109 threats classified, threats_open: 0), and 69-VALIDATION.md reconciled to nyquist_compliant with executed test evidence — all committed. A user-requested hard gate (full Desktop E2E CI matrix) was added to the plan; Steps 4-11 were not yet reached.

repo: Plan 69-14 (WinFsp platform layer) is intentionally unexecuted locally: autonomous:false, CI-only on macOS since crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/* doesn't compile under local mac cargo — SC#5 is CI-authoritative.

desktop-e2e.yml's workflow_dispatch takes no inputs; `gh workflow run "Desktop E2E Tests" --ref <branch>` runs the full macOS/Windows/Linux matrix. ci-e2e.yml is a separate orchestrator whose desktop-e2e job dispatches the same matrix plus web-e2e.

Phase 69 touches zero TypeScript runtime code (packages/sdk/src, sdk-core/src, apps/api/src, api-client/src all untouched) — only sdk-core/scripts/*.mts + tsconfig.scripts.json changed, so the TS sdk-e2e suite is not implicated for this phase.
69-VALIDATION.md's Manual-Only section had a stale 'CI E2E Tests' dispatch handle that the plan itself flagged as a 404; correct handle is 'Desktop E2E Tests'.
Root-level SECURITY.md at repo root predates this phase (June 14) and is untouched by phase work — must be kept distinct from the per-phase 69-SECURITY.md doc.
CI grep gates enforce phase invariants directly: ci.yml:757 enforces deletion of spawn_file_meta_reencrypt, ci.yml:748 enforces no inline resolve_published_node/unseal in fuse crate.
Phase 69 threat register: 109 threats total (2 critical, 79 high, 21 medium, 7 low); 25 are supply-chain '-SC' rows that all close on a single 'no new dependencies' diff check.

code.finding: Delegates key unwrapping to SDK symmetric chain (unseal_child_read_key/unseal_child_write_key/unseal_node) rather than ECIES — satisfies SC#1.
build_node_aad implements node-AAD transplant used by the symmetric unwrap chain.
gate_scope_exit: no covering grant → NoRotation pure relink (zero publishes); covering grant → rotate exactly once via SDK rotate_read_from_node.
enum Node { Folder{children}, File{content}, Root{children} } — the unified node representation targeted by SC#4.
rotate_read_on_scope_exit returns Err→EIO because no production RotationDeps implementor exists yet (only FakeDeps in the engine) — fail-closed but not live-wired; matches known ROT-07 gap.

workflow: Per prior guidance, orchestrator runs heavy/full test suites itself (in background) rather than delegating to subagents, to avoid RAM starvation from concurrent suites.

Long-running verifier/auditor subagents can stall mid-stream (API Error: Response stalled) after several minutes without producing any output; recovery is to reconstruct the deliverable manually from already-gathered evidence rather than blindly re-spawning.
SendMessage can inject fresh evidence or new requirements into an in-flight background agent (e.g., feeding test results, relaying a mid-session user requirement) without restarting it.

gsd-verify-work skill's default flow is conversational UAT; for autonomous ship loops the canonical goal-backward 69-VERIFICATION.md must be generated directly instead of following the skill's human-in-the-loop path.

friction: Target branch was already checked out in a separate worktree (cipher-box-phase69), blocking `git switch` until the worktree was verified clean and removed.
No 69-VERIFICATION.md existed going into Step 1 — execute-phase's verify step never produced one, requiring a manual goal-backward verification pass instead of the skill's default conversational UAT.
Security auditor subagent stalled mid-stream after ~458s/17 tool uses with zero output written, forcing the report to be assembled by hand from the gathered threat register and verification evidence.
An initial disposition count ('6 accept') was wrong because it counted the word 'accept' in prose rather than the actual disposition column; had to redo the count from the clean structured data.
